title: Reconciliar bootstrap de novo chat com efeitos reais no ChatGPT
objective: Corrigir o fluxo de criação/rebootstrap de novos chats para que o estado interno do runtime reconcilie efeitos externos tardios e nunca permaneça ERROR quando evidência correlacionada comprovar que o attempt original criou a conversa, entregou o user turn e recebeu o marker esperado.

problem.observed: Em smoke real de seis agentes, Sofia reproduziu message_send_unconfirmed e runtime ERROR/handshakeVerified=false, embora uma conversa nova no projeto SOPHIA tenha sido criada e tenha produzido resposta válida. Em paralelo, dois panes da mesma instância competem pelo lock do Bridge e um pode receber automation_busy.
problem.core_invariant: message_send_unconfirmed nao prova nao-entrega; representa incerteza e exige reconciliacao antes de qualquer retry.
problem.duplicate_prevention: Nenhum retry pode reenviar bootstrap enquanto existir possibilidade de o attempt original ter produzido efeito externo.

scope: late positive evidence reconciliation for identity bootstrap/new-chat
recovery of original attempt to READY when correlated evidence is proven
same-instance pane serialization or equivalent deterministic queuing
out_of_scope: mark READY from timeout, silence or nominal state alone
acceptance_criteria: six of six agents create exactly one new conversation in the correct ChatGPT project
six of six final identities are READY with handshakeVerified=true
delayed-but-real delivery recovers the original attempt rather than creating a replacement attempt
restart during uncertain bootstrap reconciles before any resend
npm run check passes in the implementation repository
npm test passes in the implementation repository
final evidence records candidate SHA and HANDSHAKE_VERIFIED proof for all six agents
required_tests: delayed conversation URL plus original user turn plus expected ready marker recovers READY without resend
persisted message_send_unconfirmed can recover after restart from correlated positive evidence
wrong project, wrong agent marker or unrelated conversation cannot recover READY
no evidence keeps the state fail-closed
two simultaneous panes in one instance are serialized or queued deterministically
three independent instances may execute concurrently
six-agent end-to-end smoke completes without manual intervention
knowledge_rule_for_future_masters: Reconcile before retry. Treat external ChatGPT effects as possibly committed even when delivery confirmation times out.

selected_agents.note: runtime identity remained ERROR from the defect under investigation; direct message preserved architecture participation without blind rebootstrap
failure during dispatch is additional evidence that the delivery-confirmation defect is not Sofia-specific; final audit must be retried only after candidate fix

new_evidence: Emily pre-gate mission dispatch failed in the same operational area, strengthening the hypothesis that the defect is not agent-specific.
Sofia architecture mission was delivered successfully through the Bridge direct-message fallback with deliveryConfirmed=true, avoiding blind identity rebootstrap.
